cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Exactly as Planned
cards.instruction: Treat every exposed flaw, failed step, and unexpected consequence as proof that the scheme is unfolding by design.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The attendant found our escape-room shortcut. Exactly the response I designed for.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You told me to keep her talking so you could crawl through.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A distraction has to be detectable. Please don't confuse your role with the entire operation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's throwing us out without letting us solve a clue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't delay the exit to argue about clues. Being escorted out is the extraction I planned.
